# CI quarantine list (surefire excludesFile).
#
# NOTE: ASCII only. Surefire reads this file with the platform default charset,
# so non-ASCII characters break it with "Failed to load list from file: Input length = 1".
#
# These tests were ALREADY RED before CI existed. They are not regressions from
# any recent change. Left in the suite they would make CI red from day one, and a
# permanently red CI is the same as no CI: real regressions drown in the noise.
#
# Quarantining them restores signal. Each entry records its root cause and its exit
# condition. Fix one, delete its line.
#
# DO NOT add entries here to turn CI green. A newly failing test IS a regression;
# fix the code instead.
#
# Usage: mvn test -Dsurefire.excludesFile=<repo-root>/.github/known-test-failures.txt

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# workflow-engine-core - 2 failures, deterministic (verified: not flaky)
#
# MultiInstanceStatusController.getStatus() returns success=false, so the test
# fails at assertThat(...isSuccess()).isTrue() and never reaches the count
# assertions it is actually about. Pre-existing controller defect, unrelated to
# the Flowable 7.2.0 upgrade: git log shows these files were last touched in
# b6f6a5d06, well before it.
#
# Exit condition: debug the error branch in MultiInstanceStatusController.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
**/MultiInstanceStatusQueryConsistencyPropertyTest.java

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# platform-common - 5 failures (1 + 3, plus a shared cause)
#
# Bean Validation constraint violations that the tests do not expect
# (ConstraintViolationImpl on the configuration properties classes). Verified
# pre-existing: the same 5 failures reproduce on a git worktree of the commit
# BEFORE the Flowable 7.2.0 upgrade, so they are not caused by it.
#
# Exit condition: reconcile the @ConfigurationProperties constraints with what
# these property tests assert is valid.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
**/ConfigurationValidationPropertyTest.java
**/ExternalConfigurationLoadingPropertyTest.java

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# platform-security - 3 errors
#
# A jqwik @Property generates arbitrary passwords, including ones longer than
# BCrypt's hard 72-byte input limit, so the encoder throws
# IllegalArgumentException("password cannot be more than 72 bytes"). The
# generator is simply wider than the code under test allows. Verified
# pre-existing on the commit before the Flowable 7.2.0 upgrade.
#
# Exit condition: constrain the generator (e.g. @StringLength(max = 72)), or
# decide the application should reject over-long passwords and assert that.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
**/UserPropertyTest.java

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# user-portal - 2 errors
#
# Both read SQL from deploy/init-scripts/14-travel-expense-reimbursement/, a
# directory that does not exist in the repository (NoSuchFileException). The
# tests reference a seed package that was never committed or has been deleted;
# this is not a product-code defect.
#
# Exit condition: restore that seed directory, or delete/rewrite these tests.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
**/TravelExpenseIdempotencyPropertyTest.java
**/TravelExpenseDependencyErrorPropertyTest.java
